description: Documentation-ingestion + densification tools — intake a docs website (or PDF/page), strip the boilerplate, chunk it well, and RAISE information density so an LLM never spends tokens pulling down + parsing raw HTML. The whole point: do the HTML work ONCE, deterministically, off the model's token budget, and hand the model clean, dense, chunked, embeddable content. A registry of technique SPECS (what it does, what it saves, when to use), not implementations; pointers, never truth. Composes with the existing context stack — parser_router, document_decompose (context_rot), input_profiler, headroom compression, the embedder — and the verification rail. serves_truth=false.

tools.name: Main-content extractor (Readability/trafilatura-class)
tools.what: strip nav/ads/boilerplate -> just the article/doc body
tools.saves: 60-90% of raw-HTML tokens before the model sees anything
tools.when_to_use: rung 0 on any web doc; do this BEFORE any LLM call

tools.name: HTML -> clean structured markdown
tools.what: convert extracted HTML to markdown (headings, lists, code blocks, tables preserved)
tools.saves: tokens + gives the model a structure it parses cheaply
tools.when_to_use: after extraction; the canonical clean form to chunk/embed

tools.name: Bounded doc-site crawler
tools.what: intake a whole docs site via sitemap/nav, deduped + scoped, politely (ToS/robots)
tools.saves: one governed pass vs the model fetching pages ad hoc
tools.when_to_use: ingesting a full documentation set; pair with caching

tools.name: Structure-aware semantic chunker
tools.what: chunk by heading/section/semantic boundary (not fixed-size), with overlap + heading context on each chunk
tools.saves: retrieval precision -> fewer, more-relevant chunks per query
tools.when_to_use: before embedding; the chunk quality IS the retrieval quality

tools.name: Information-density compressor
tools.what: dedupe boilerplate/repeated nav, drop low-signal text, keep answer-critical facts + source handles (lossless on the facts)
tools.saves: shrinks the text surface 12-40% while keeping the facts
tools.when_to_use: dense docs with repetition; LOSSLESS rule — answer-critical facts + source handles survive

tools.name: Chunk embedder + index
tools.what: embed clean chunks -> pgvector index for retrieval (local nomic-embed-text by default, keyless)
tools.saves: the model retrieves the 3 right chunks instead of reading the whole site
tools.when_to_use: after chunking; the durable retrieval substrate

tools.name: Extract-once content cache
tools.what: extract + clean + chunk ONCE, cache by content-hash; serve the cached dense form on every later read
tools.saves: eliminates re-fetching + re-parsing raw HTML on repeat access — the core 'don't make the LLM do HTML' win
tools.when_to_use: any repeatedly-read doc source; the governed serving form

tools.name: Born-digital fast path
tools.what: detect already-clean/structured docs (markdown, JSON, OpenAPI) and SKIP extraction/OCR entirely
tools.saves: the whole extraction cost when it isn't needed
tools.when_to_use: rung 0 of the input profiler — route clean inputs straight to chunking
